reason: A local DeepSeek Harness analytics plugin that processes session usage into token-cost, cache, budget, and session insights through APIs, an agent tool, and browser dashboards.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 收集并分析会话用量，在本地计算令牌成本、缓存、预算和会话明细，并通过 API、智能体工具及浏览器仪表板提供查询。
summaries.en: Collects and analyzes DeepSeek Harness session usage locally, calculating token costs, cache metrics, budgets, and session details through APIs, an agent tool, and browser dashboards.

capabilities: Collects session usage and tool-call events
Stores analytics data in a local SQLite database
Calculates time-aware token costs, cache metrics, budgets, and session summaries
Provides read-only service methods, an agent query tool, JSON API routes, and browser dashboards
